blockingLoop.evidence: Identical reply twice: 'so I can't diagnose that one.' despite the customer pointing out vacuum cleaners are covered

rationale: The assistant refused a robot vacuum while listing vacuum cleaners as covered, then repeated the identical refusal when the customer pointed out the contradiction. It gave no Error 2 explanation, no brush-cleaning guidance and no pointer to iRobot support. The case was in scope and easily solved by cleaning the brushes and end caps, so the customer was left with nothing useful.
